definitions.allocated_spending_m_eur: Country-attributed EU expenditure plus separately reported NextGenerationEU expenditure.
definitions.national_contribution_m_eur: VAT-, GNI- and plastics-based own resources plus balances and adjustments; excludes traditional own resources.
definitions.total_own_resources_m_eur: National contribution plus traditional own resources, principally customs duties.
definitions.traditional_own_resources_m_eur: Sugar levies plus customs duties reported for the country.
definitions.accounting_difference_m_eur: Allocated spending minus national contribution; a transparent arithmetic comparison, not the Commission's operating budgetary balance.
